concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE polished logo concept presentation for Vaulty, a premium European personal and business document organizer. Concept 01: EDITORIAL FOLDED V. A distinctive minimal geometric V emblem constructed from two folded document planes, very simple bold silhouette and tasteful negative space. Pair with a beautiful bespoke editorial serif wordmark exactly 'Vaulty.' with a small bronze final dot. Ink #242724 and muted bronze #8B7355 on flat warm ivory #F7F5F0. Composition: elegant spacious landscape brand sheet, top-left tiny '01', main horizontal emblem + wordmark centered in upper two thirds, bottom row shows SAME emblem alone twice as favicon proposals: an enlarged simple icon on ivory and its ivory reversed version inside a solid bronze rounded square. The favicon must be recognizable at 16px, no thin lines or tiny detail. Flat vector-like shapes, exceptionally clean edges and precise optical spacing; no 3D, no texture, no lighting, no shadows, no mockup device, no gradients, no shields/locks/keys/clipart, no tagline, no other words. Three visual items total: primary lockup plus the two consistent favicon color variants. Design as a thoughtful independent identity studio, restrained and warm. This is a preview concept, do not show fake browser screenshots.

Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE refined logo concept presentation for 'Vaulty', a premium European document organizing app. Concept 02: SOFT ARCHIVE. Design a compact friendly geometric document mark: a rounded upright archive/document tab, with a strong simple V-shaped negative-space cutout formed by two gently converging bold strokes inside. A restrained visual idea of organized pages and a safe place; intentionally very different from a folded leaf or a serif V. Pair with custom modern humanist sans-serif wordmark exactly 'vaulty' in lowercase, excellent spacing, medium weight with a subtly distinctive y. Colors deep warm ink #242724 and soft sage #879184 on flat ivory #F7F5F0. Composition: spacious landscape brand sheet; tiny '02' top left; main horizontal icon + wordmark centered in upper two thirds, bottom row SAME icon alone twice: enlarged sage monochrome favicon on ivory and ivory reversed favicon inside a solid dark sage rounded square. Clear at 16px, bold recognizable silhouette and open negative spaces. Flat vector-like design, warm premium calm trustworthy; no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no texture, no mockup objects, no literal lock/key/shield, no thin tiny lines, no tagline or extraneous text. Match emblem and favicon precisely. Three visual items total: primary lockup and two favicon color options.

Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE premium original logo concept presentation for 'Vaulty'. Concept 03: ARCHITECTURAL MONOGRAM, a quiet sophisticated European document archive. An exceptionally simple monogram: a strong uppercase V inside an open square outline, with the V lower vertex aligned to a deliberate central gap in the square's bottom edge. The square suggests an orderly archive compartment, not a shield or padlock. Only 2-3 bold geometric strokes, clear balanced negative space, no small details. Pair with a sophisticated restrained medium-contrast serif wordmark exactly 'Vaulty', less dramatic and more architectural than a fashion Didone; carefully spaced, refined, highly legible. Colors muted bronze #8B7355 for monogram and warm ink #242724 for type, on flat warm ivory #F7F5F0. Spacious landscape brand sheet, tiny '03' in top-left; main horizontal icon+wordmark centered upper two thirds. Bottom row shows precisely SAME monogram as an enlarged bronze standalone favicon, and ivory reversed inside a solid ink rounded square. Favicon must work at 16px, no narrow delicate lines. Three visual items total: main lockup plus two favicon color variants. Flat vector-like edges. No gradients, shadows, 3D, texture, devices, mockups, extra decorations, slogans or other words. Understated premium document management identity, visually distinct from a folded-paper V or rounded document icon.
